subject: Fix battle_decisions us-list PCs + swap commits + avenger fallback
description:
DONE by fix-battledec2 on branch worktree-agent-a7bd1cc12fe038a73 (worktree .claude/worktrees/agent-a7bd1cc12fe038a73), commits 37e5149b1 + b50a7b200, merged baseline 71cd5e503 (sweep commit) via bb090ed32 so validation frames are comparable.

Implemented all three gaps from the prior findings: (a) battle_decisions now walks tick.fighter_registry for same-side PCs (is_pc && is_friendly && is_able_to_fight + battle_friend_detected_360 gate), pushes them into list_us and bumps friends_lower_company when company_number > 0; detection.rs us-fact precompute now compares ss.camp != my_camp (note: that block is inside a viewer.camp == Lacklandists gate, so this half was behaviorally inert). (b) friend_primary_target_swap Option -> friend_primary_target_swaps Vec through AiActorOutbox/AiActorCoreEffects/has_boundary_work/take_core and the engine drain applies every queued swap; the reconsider loop retargets each improving friend immediately and updates self primary_target per-iteration. (c) avenger-on-roof wait positions precomputed per candidate target (enemy_ai.list_them + current primary target) ABOVE the no-target early return; new tick.avenger_wait_position_for(handle) lookup; DECISION_OBSERVE non-trainer arm takes the roof fallback for its re-picked target, sets seek_position to Position(target), and returns without registering LOG_BATTLE_DECISION (execute_battle_decision now returns bool, caller gates the log line); the reconsider-path fallback resolves its own live handle so a swapped target no longer reuses the snapshot target's wait position.

Validation (debug, vs resweep-71cd5e503 logs): PC repro 60s-15x/SuN1Sh1nE/P004/SG036/replay-011 advanced 1114 -> 1248 and the ai.list_us mismatch (missing PC 316/319) is gone (new first divergence is projectile/movement, different gap). Controls SuN1Sh1nE/P004/ExQuickSave/replay-002 and linux3/P001/SG010/replay-013 still exit 0 full match. The other two ai.list_us-classified repros (linux3/P001/SG036/r002 frame 33630, linux3/P003/Continue/r009 frame 13778) are unchanged — their mismatches are all-soldier us-list composition rooted in 360-gate LOS/detection (rust misses/adds soldiers or a detectable), not the PC/swap/avenger gaps; needs a separate detection-LOS investigation.
